title: Vendor Agreement Enumerations
description: Canonical vendor agreement vocabularies, owned by PRO. Add members over minor versions; never repurpose one.

AgreementType.description: SUPPLY = master supply or distribution agreement. REBATE = volume or growth rebate terms. MARKETING = co-op or market development funds. PRICING = pricing addendum or special pricing. OTHER = anything else (NDA, warranty, service).

AgreementStatus.description: DRAFT = not yet signed. ACTIVE = signed and in force. EXPIRED = term ended. TERMINATED = ended early. 'Expiring soon' is not a status: it is derived from term.effectiveTo.

ValueBasis.description: What the amount measures. PER_YEAR = annual value. TOTAL = value over the whole term. ONE_TIME = a single payment or fund.
